topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines its core learning objectives.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss conventional cancer treatment modalities alongside the systemic toxicities and efflux-mediated resistance mechanisms associated with cytotoxic agents.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic vulnerabilities and checkpoint defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities, including hormone dependencies, cell-cycle checkpoint deficiencies, and synthetic lethality in DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibition and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover targeted kinase inhibition driven by oncogene addiction and the molecular mechanisms that lead to resistance and drug addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibody therapies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms and clinical utility of targeted monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and cellular immunotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer immunology and immunotherapeutic interventions ranging from immune checkpoint blockade to engineered T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Clinical progress, treatment challenges, and future paradigms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on historical clinical progress, contemporary challenges in treatment resistance, and emerging paradigms in future cancer management.
